description: Per-field options for a prefix term-level clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed prefix map (the map key is the column name). A leading * or ? in value is rejected (it forces a full index scan).

value.description: Required. The prefix the indexed term must start with. A string (or scalar value on a non-text column).

case_insensitive.description: Optional. When true, matches the prefix regardless of case. Default false.

rewrite.description: Optional. How the multi-term query is rewritten internally.

boost.description: Optional. Multiplier for the relevance score of this clause. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.
